messages:
claire: opened a focused docs PR for Private installs - covers switching PKCS#11 providers, split-DNS notes for SNI, a tiny nftables + iptables example, and a short Windows netsh line. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5350
docsmgr: Thanks Claire. Keep the page short (one page). Two asks: 1) include explicit PKCS#11 URI examples for common HSM patterns, 2) add a single-line security verification step for offline bundles.
ivan: PKCS#11 examples to paste: `pkcs11:token=acme;object=bastion-key` and `pkcs11:slot-id=1;object=server-cert`. Note vendors vary on labels vs numeric IDs.
ivan: nftables minimal (ipv4):
```
# minimal nftables for proxy host
table ip filter {
  chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; ct state established,related accept; iifname "lo" accept; tcp dport 443 ct state new accept; }
}
```
iptables fallback: `iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT`
ivan: Windows one-liner (run as admin): `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4 listenport=443 listenaddress=0.0.0.0 connectport=8080 connectaddress=127.0.0.1` + firewall rule to allow 443.
qa-bot: CI for PR #5350  docs-linter: passed, linkcheck: failed (1 moved anchor). Report: https://ci.redwood/links/5350
claire: fixed the anchor, added PKCS#11 examples and a one-line security note. Pushed update.
security: Add final mandatory verification line: "Verify GPG signatures and SHA256 checksums for all offline artifacts before installation in air-gapped environments; record the provider GPG fingerprint in your install playbook." Keep it short.
docsmgr: Please also add a 3-bullet troubleshooting checklist: 1) tcpdump/tshark to inspect ClientHello SNI, 2) curl --resolve to force DNS to the proxy, 3) check proxy TLS handshake logs for ALPN/cert issues.
claire: Added troubleshooting bullets and two quick smoke-test commands: `openssl s_client -connect localhost:443 -servername example.internal -showcerts` and `curl --resolve example.internal:443:127.0.0.1 https://example.internal/health -v`.
qa-bot: CI for PR #5350  all checks passed :white_check_mark:
docsmgr: LGTM, merging. Thanks all! :shipit:
